name: ifg
description: For tax professionals. Claude reads official tax texts at the date of the facts, with status, versions and clickable publisher links. Covers 32 European jurisdictions (all 27 EU states, French overseas, Switzerland and cantons, the UK, Monaco, Andorra, Liechtenstein) and Israel, plus bilateral tax treaties, EU law, OECD and UN Models. 7-day free trial, no card.
